name: promobento
description: PromoBento native huashu-motion authoring and Cloudflare control plane.

scripts.test: pnpm run build:validators && pnpm run build:web && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:validators && pnpm --filter @promobento/cloud typecheck && pnpm --filter @promobento/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @promobento/preview typecheck
scripts.test:native: pnpm run build:validators && node --test packages/contracts/test/canonical.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/validation.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/native-project.test.mjs packages/native-motion/test/*.test.mjs apps/render-container/tests/io.test.mjs apps/render-container/tests/media-precheck.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/director-stages.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/native-*.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/model-secret.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/recovery-indexes.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/model-budget.test.mjs packages/models/test/adapters.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/models.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/v3-schemas.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/video-frames.test.mjs packages/contracts/test/png.test.mjs packages/methods/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:saas-local: pnpm run build:validators && pnpm run build:web && node --test packages/contracts/test/http-routes.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/api-dispatch.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/guarded-batch.test.mjs apps/cloud/test/multi-worker.test.mjs apps/web/test/*.test.mjs scripts/check-saas-foundation.test.mjs
